context_requirements: Expression of DDC and a monoamine/aromatic amino acid substrate pool sufficient to make decarboxylation flux limiting
Cell lineage with active aromatic amino acid decarboxylation (e.g. neuroendocrine, enterochromaffin-like, renal proximal tubule, hepatic)
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of DDC pathway target engagement producing downstream monoamine-responsive gene changes
